title: Waypoint Follower
text: Follow waypoints for UAV, 3 inputs, 6 outputs; {UAV type} sets the type of UAV, {StartFrom} sets the waypoint start behavior, {Transition radius source} sets the source of transition, {Transition radius (r)} sets the transition radius for waypoints, {Minimum lookahead distance (m)}, {Hover at last waypoint} sets the lookahead point location at last waypoint, {Show Yaw input variable} sets the accept yaw input for waypoints, {Show CrossTrackError output port} sets the output cross track error, {Show UAV Status output port} sets the output UAV waypoint status and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Pose
ports.summary: Current UAV pose [x y z chi] vector

ports.name: Waypoints
ports.summary: Set of waypoints n -by-3 matrix | n -by-4 matrix | n -by-5 matrix

ports.name: LookaheadPoint
ports.summary: Lookahead point on path [x y z] position vector

ports.name: CrossTrackError
ports.summary: Cross track error from UAV position to path positive numeric scalar

params.name: Transition radius source
params.values: Source of transition radius internal (default) | external

params.name: Transition radius (r)
params.values: Transition radius for waypoints 10 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: Minimum lookahead distance (m)
params.values: Minimum lookahead distance 0.1 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: Hover at last waypoint
params.values: Lookahead point location at last waypoint off (default) | on

params.name: Show Yaw input variable
params.values: Accept yaw input for waypoints off (default) | on

params.name: Show CrossTrackError output port
params.values: Output cross track error off (default) | on

params.name: Show UAV Status output port
params.values: Output UAV waypoint status off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
